# WalletOS
> Digital loyalty cards for small and medium businesses — customers add a stamp, points, or steps loyalty card straight to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, no app to download. Bilingual Arabic and English, built MENA/GCC first.

- Loyalty programs -> https://www.walletos.online/en/features/programs: Stamp, points, and steps program types
- Live updates -> https://www.walletos.online/en/features/updates: How wallet passes refresh after a scan

## Key facts
- No app download required — cards live natively in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet
- Signup to a live enrollment QR code in under two minutes
- Three loyalty program types: stamp cards, points, and multi-stage steps
- Bilingual Arabic/English, MENA/GCC-first
- Free plan available (1 program, up to 100 customers); paid plans start at Starter

## Also available in Arabic
Every page above has an Arabic equivalent at the same path under /ar/ instead of /en/, e.g. https://www.walletos.online/ar/pricing
